content:
As the Liquid Glass redesign continues to roll out to most iOS WhatsApp users, the messaging platform is testing another visual change, this time focusing on the appearance of chat bubbles. Here's what we know so far.

A new, rounder chat bubble design

Months ago, WhatsApp finally began rolling out the Liquid Glass redesign more broadly, after months of testing and refinement with select users via TestFlight.

Around the same time, WABetaInfo spotted signs in the app's code suggesting that WhatsApp's chat bubbles were set for a redesign. The site now reports that the new bubble design has begun rolling out to some users running the latest TestFlight build.

Here's what WABetaInfo reported:

Besides the change in the shape of message bubbles, the new design also alters how media and links appear in conversations. WhatsApp has removed the green borders around them, giving photos, videos, animated GIFs, and link previews a cleaner, more unified look.

According to WABetaInfo, the new look is currently only available to a small number of users running the WhatsApp TestFlight build, and there's no timeline yet for a wider rollout to all iOS users.
